selected.title: Bank of England orders review of Revolut product approvals - FT
selected.summary: The Bank of England has instigated a review into how Revolut's product approval process works, according to the Financial Times.
selected.why: Bank of England ordering a review into Revolut's product approvals represents significant regulatory scrutiny.

reason: Bank of England's Revolut review raises substantive questions about regulatory approach to fintech product oversight and whether prescriptive approval processes protect consumers or stifle innovation.
angle: Regulatory micro-management of fintech product approvals risks shifting responsibility from firms to regulators without improving consumer outcomes.
